sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Ops phone at 40%, good enough to use for patrols.
Commencing Alpha Route. Arrived at check-in corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street Headquarters. Welfare check:
Arrived at check-in Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square, full sweep around the area. All clear.
During sweep, received a response call from 175 Queen Street QBE requesting assistance to move a vagrant on from the front entrance.
While en route to the response call, received a call back to stand down — the individual has left the area.
Resuming routes. Cut through and welfare check Elliott Street:
Response call from Starbucks Queen St regarding a male who has used their restroom for over an hour but has not come out; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call and gave the individual a two-knock warning to exit the premises; he complied and left.
Stopping by Headquarters to grab a new key swipe from Ravi, Datacentre.
Standing by middle of Queen Street to show presence, awaiting Team 2 to be deployed together.
Team 2 deployed; they will patrol lower Queen Street while we deploy upper Queen Street.
Ending Alpha Route and commencing Delta Route for upper Queen Street.
Arrived at check-in corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne St. All clear.
Arrived at check-in Auckland Town Hall. All clear.
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square. All clear.
Response call from Mobile Planet regarding an individual sitting outside their store; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call; staff said another female vagrant had come and taken him along with her.
Standing by to show presence before moving to the next checkpoint.
Ending Delta Route and commencing Echo Route for upper Queen Street.
Arrived at check-in corner of Darby St and Queen St. All clear.
Arrived at check-in top of Victoria St and Federal St. All clear.
Heading down to Queen Street towards Lorne St.
Swinging back down to Queen Street through Wellesley Street East.
Standing by middle of Queen Street while remaining vigilant.
Welfare check on stores along Wellesley Street West:
Heading back to Headquarters to charge ops phone battery (at 10%).
Call from management to bring up both cameras and chargers.
Welfare check on Strand Arcade and all stores within the vicinity. All clear.
Welfare check through Midcity Arcade and all stores within the vicinity. All clear.
Arrived back at Headquarters to use restroom.

Received a message from Nick, Datacentre, that the Level 1 electrician was assaulted yesterday at midday over a cigarette by Stewart, a known repeat offender. No footage was recovered but the victim has launched a statement through Ross at Datacentre; manager Nicholas will collect it. Afternoon team to be debriefed and to keep a sharp eye out for the individual.
Standing by middle of Queen Street while remaining vigilant.
Standing by for changeover to afternoon shift.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Equipment received: 1 x Camera, 1 x Radio, 2 x Vests. Standing by HQ debriefing with Team 1.
Debrief with Team 1 complete over phone call; route patrol confirmed. Heading down Queen St for welfare checks.
Welfare check on the first half of lower Queen St complete; continuing patrol for the rest of lower Queen St.
Welfare sweep on the rest of lower Queen St complete, no issues on local stores. Full welfare sweep on Commercial Bay, no issues. Heading over to Gore St / Fort St.

Welfare sweep on Gore St / Fort St complete. An aggressive man on Gore St heading into Fort St was causing a disturbance of the peace in public. My partner and I approached and calmly did a welfare check on the vagrant; he was compliant when asked questions but still acting aggressive towards us. We managed to calm him down and move him along. No further issues. Conversation duration approximately 15–20 minutes.
Fort St clear, no issues. Heading over to Freyberg via High St.
Welfare sweep along High St clear, no issues on local stores.
Welfare sweep on Freyberg / Chancery Sq complete, no issues. Standing by Chancery Square.
Heading back to HQ for route changeover.
Standing by HQ for debrief with Team 1 for route changeover.
Welfare checks on stores going up Queen St, clear, no issues. Making our way to Elliott St.
Elliott St / Darby sweep complete, welfare check clear, no issues. Continuing patrol to Aotea.
Arrived at Aotea Square, starting welfare sweeps.
Welfare sweeps complete, no issues. Standing by for response calls from Team 1.
Resuming patrol, making our way to Victoria St for welfare checks.
Welfare sweeps along Victoria St complete, no issues. Heading to the Cathedral for welfare check, clear.
Quick sweep along Federal St complete, no issues.
Welfare check on the Cathedral, clear, no issues. Making our way back to HQ for route changeover.
Route changeover complete. Heading down Queen St for welfare sweeps.
Welfare sweep on local stores down Queen St complete, no issues. Heading to Commercial Bay.
Arriving at Commercial Bay, commencing welfare sweep.
Welfare sweep complete on Commercial Bay, no issues. Heading to Gore / Fort.
Gore and Fort St sweep complete, no issues to report.
Welfare sweep along High St complete, no issues from local stores. Heading towards Chancery / Freyberg Sq.
Freyberg / Chancery Sq complete, no issues.
Welfare sweep complete, no issues. Continuing foot patrol onto Queen St to maintain security presence.
No issues to report on Queen St. Heading back to HQ for our 30 minutes.
Team 2 complete, all equipment handed in. Team 1 notified. No further issues to report.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Commencing full sweep of Commercial Bay, maintaining a visible presence to the public.
Commencing patrols along Albert Street; all stores all clear, no issues to report.
Response call from Lovisa reporting a theft — a suspect who took multiple items from them; they gave us the suspect's location heading up Queen St.
Spotted the male who stole from Lovisa; we got the upper hand and recovered the items. All clear, no further issues.
Another item he had stolen was found in his bag but it was unclear which store it was taken from, so the item was returned to HQ.
Response call from Starbucks Queen Street reporting a vagrant inside their store.
Removed him from the premises; as he had been removed earlier in the day he has left. No further issues. Standing by in case he returns.
Arrived at High St; welfare checks on stores along High St.
Arrived at Chancery Sq / Freyberg Sq; welfare checks on stores. All clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of Chancery Sq / Freyberg Sq complete, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Arrived at Fort St, commencing a full sweep down to Gore St with welfare checks on stores.
Arrived at Gore St; full sweep of Fort St, Commerce St, Pocket Park and Gore St complete. Welfare checks on stores all clear. Standing by.
Response call from New World Metro Queen St about 2 vagrants sitting outside their store with a dog; asked for assistance moving them along.
Arrived at New World; told the vagrants to move along as they were disrupting business; they complied and left without further issues. (Footage on body cam.)
Response call from Chancery Carpark about a vagrant in the car park making a worker uncomfortable.
Arrived at Chancery Carpark; escorted the lady to her car and did a full sweep of the carpark. All clear, no sign of the male vagrant. (Photo on file.)
Returning to HQ to charge the ops phone (at 10%).
Building checks and floor checks completed.
Commencing Alpha Route. Full sweep around the area, making presence known to members of the public.
While on patrols, spotted the vagrant who assaulted the Datacentre worker in the earlier incident; the male is located on Elliott St. Standing by in case he harms any of the public.
Arrived at Aotea Sq check-in; welfare check on stores along Queen St complete. All clear, no issues to report.
Aotea Sq sweep complete, all clear. Standing by for response calls, problematic issues or vagrants in the area.
Auckland Library full sweep completed, no issues to report.
Arrived at Lorne Street, commencing a full sweep down to High St with welfare checks on stores.
Arrived at the corner of High St; welfare check on stores along Lorne St. All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Chancery Sq / Freyberg Sq.
Freyberg Sq / Chancery Sq sweep complete, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Fort Street full sweep around the area, no issues to report.
Arrived at Gore St; welfare checks on stores and sweep complete, all clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Commercial Bay sweep complete, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Response call from McDonald's Queen St regarding vagrants inside their store; asked for assistance removing them from the premises.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen St; manager pointed out the vagrant, we asked them to leave and they complied. All clear. Standing by.
While on standby, another vagrant went inside and begged for food; we asked her to leave and she complied. No issues. Standing by.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a male going through their rubbish and refusing to leave; manager asked for assistance removing him.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; manager pointed out the person, we informed him he had to leave and he complied and left. No issues. Standing by.
Arrived back at HQ; charging ops phone due to low percentage.
Response call from Right Track about a male who is intoxicated and refusing to leave their premises.
Arrived at Right Track; informed the male to leave, he complied but we had to help him as he couldn't walk due to being intoxicated. Standing by.
Afternoon shift complete, handover to night shift.
Equipment handover: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues to report.
Check-in Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Albert St Convenience Store, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria St, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ.
On standby outside Bar 101 showing presence.
Response call from Munster Inn due to an individual refusing to leave the site.
Arrived on site; politely asked the individual to leave, he complied and left the premises. No further issues. On standby until he gains distance; no sign of him nearby.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear; a few people hanging around the lights but no issues.
Full sweep Timezone / Red Radisson entrances; asked one individual to move along from the entrance. No further issues.
Check-in Queen St Maccas, no issues.
On standby at Bar 101 showing presence.
Bar 101 all clear, no issues to report. Alpha Route complete.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener St, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Gore St, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep St Patricks Sq, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria St, all clear, no issues.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Aotea Square, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Queen St Maccas; removed vagrants sleeping inside. No further issues.
Break over, heading back out on patrols.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham St, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Durham St, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in Fort St, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Chancery Square / Freyberg Square, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone.
On standby at HQ charging ops phone and waiting for changeover.
